source: Suno lyric panel checked against the master audio; English translations follow each source line; screamer cues are aligned to the lead-vocal stem.

lines.text: Acércate al fuego, no tengas temor,
lines.translation: Come closer to the fire; don't be afraid.

lines.text: os traigo una historia de puro terror.
lines.translation: I'll tell you a story of pure terror.

lines.text: De gente inconsciente, sin alma ni ley,
lines.translation: Of heedless souls with no conscience, heart, or law,

lines.text: que sube una PR y no sabe ni qué.
lines.translation: who raise a PR without knowing what it's for.

lines.text: Mirad a las sombras, prestad atención:
lines.translation: Look into the shadows; listen close:

lines.text: ¡Alguien metió un jest.mock sin ningún control!
lines.translation: Someone slipped in a jest.mock with no control!

lines.text: Pasó un componente por prop sin render,
lines.translation: A component passed as a prop, never rendered,

lines.text: ¡y en plena mayúscula, no puede ser!
lines.translation: And all caps, too—this can't be right!
In frontend-shell, they composed
from their very own library—what betrayal!
Chills in production!
Oh, be careful what you do!

lines.text: Que en Front-line vigilan lo que subéis.
lines.translation: Front-line is watching what you push.
Jota-Jota, Puche, and Miguel show no mercy...

lines.text: ¡El Request changes te espera en la oscuridad!
lines.translation: Request Changes is waiting for you in the dark!
It was…
He rejected that PR!

lines.text: Calma, muchachos, la noche es hostil,
lines.translation: Easy now, friends; the night is hostile,

lines.text: ¡que el mal nos acecha en cada commit!
lines.translation: evil lurks in every commit!

lines.text: Hay almas perdidas, de sangre muy fría,
lines.translation: Lost souls with blood as cold as ice,

lines.text: que borran CI checks rojos a la luz del día.
lines.translation: who turn CI checks red in broad daylight.
MFE requirements, locked down tight,

lines.text: ¡y meten un cambio que no toca otra vez!
lines.translation: yet they sneak in an unrelated change again!
And in Prisma Design System,
how cruel!
They slipped in a breaking change
without warning!
The build is dead!
Oh, be careful what you do!

lines.text: Que en Front-line vigilan lo que subéis.
lines.translation: Front-line is watching what you push.
Miguel, Puche, and Jota-Jota show no mercy...

lines.text: ¡El revert te espera en la oscuridad!
lines.translation: The revert is waiting for you in the dark!
No! It's…
You're not safe!
Everything's tested,
ready to ship...

lines.text: Son las dos de la tarde,
lines.translation: It's two in the afternoon,
we're about to clock off...

lines.text: Pero suena un mensaje en el chat general...
lines.translation: But a message comes in the team chat...
A cursed line,
a fatal omen...
Hey, sorry...
it's just a tiny change...
Will you wait for the release?
